desc:
⚠️ WARNING ⚠️
SAURUS offers some of the most realistic and horrifying depictions of dinosaurs. The game is still in active development as we continue to improve on their behavior, environment and the user experience. The game contains loud noises, flashing lights and screen shaking. 

Captured by a mysterious organization, you're forced to survive terrifying dinosaurs for their entertainment. Every choice matters, the next one could be your last. Will you escape?

- Face the monstrous Tyrannosaurus Rex and the unrelenting Carnotaurus! (More dinosaurs coming!)
- Enter the enclosure solo or with a group of up to 5 people!
- Enable challenge modifiers for greater rewards and a more intense experience!
- Reach personal records and see where you rank globally!

🎧Headphones & Max graphics recommended.
🎮 All devices supported.

🎁 Roblox+ users earn double the premium currency!

⭐ Remember to like & favorite the game and leave feedback so we can continue to improve! ⭐
